title.en: It says sent, but it never arrived. Where do you look?
title.zh-Hans: 显示成功却没到账，该查哪里？

timing_note: Line and word timings are aligned to measured narration wavs (episodes/narration-timing.json); words are spread proportionally within each measured line. On-screen zh-Hans captions follow the English narration timing.

narration.command_template: python -m mlx_audio.tts.generate --model mlx-community/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base-8bit --lang_code en --ref_audio /Volumes/致态2TB/nx-agents/education/v2/voice-en-master-reference.wav --ref_text "Your KYC got rejected again? Don't worry. Most rejections come down to just a few simple mistakes. Let's fix them together." --text "<line>" --output_path <dir> --file_prefix <name>
narration.english_voice_instruct: a cheerful young American woman in her twenties, warm and energetic, clear diction, friendly YouTube tutorial host
narration.sam_voice_design_instruct: a friendly adult American man new to crypto, natural and conversational, clear diction, curious but not cartoonish
narration.sam_voice_note: Task-specific brief requests Sam lines with this distinct VoiceDesign model; this overrides the older global owner note that male voice was not used.

open_visual_en: Brand open (3 s): official NexuAlpha logo mark + wordmark (imported SVG, never redrawn, proportions locked) eases in centre-left; series title, 'S1 · E10' and the episode title slide in beside it; fixed short brand sting. Nexubo pops up from the bottom edge with a squash-and-stretch landing, antenna blue.
open_visual_zh: 品牌片头（3秒）：正式标志图形＋文字标（导入原始SVG，不重画、不变比例）淡入；旁边显示系列名、“第1季 · 第10集”与本集标题；固定短音效。小纳从画面下沿弹出落地，天线蓝灯。

shots.visual_en: Sender shows 'Submitted'; the receiver still shows zero. Sam is about to send three more times. Antenna red, ding, chip 'Stop. Don't resend'.
shots.visual_zh: 发送端显示已提交，接收端仍为零，小白准备连续再转三次。天线红灯“叮”，红色警示条“停，别重复转”。

text.en: It didn't arrive. Should I just send a few more?
text.zh-Hans: 没到账，我再转几笔试试？

message.zh-Hans: 已提交 · 接收方仍显示 0

shots.source_visual_zh: 发送端显示已提交，接收端仍为零，小白准备连续再转三次。天线红灯“叮”，红色警示条“停，别重复转”。

shots.visual_en: A progress route with three stations: Sender processing → On-chain confirmation → Receiver credits.
shots.visual_zh: 进度路线分成三站：发送方处理→链上确认→接收方入账。
shots.onscreen_text_en: Find the station where it's stuck

text.en: Don't send again. Submitted, on-chain and credited are not the same thing. Find which station it's stuck at, then decide who to contact.
text.zh-Hans: 先别重复转。已提交、已上链、已入账不是一回事。先确认卡在哪一站，再决定该联系谁。

shots.source_visual_zh: 进度路线分成三站：发送方处理→链上确认→接收方入账。

shots.visual_en: Open the send record: network, address, amount, transaction hash; a block explorer shows read-only status.
shots.visual_zh: 打开发送记录：网络、地址、数量、交易哈希；浏览器查询只读状态。

text.en: Keep the send record. If there's a transaction hash, check it on a proper block explorer for that network: status, destination address and amount. Don't mix in results from a different chain.
text.zh-Hans: 保存发送记录。若有交易哈希，在对应网络的正规区块浏览器查看状态、目标地址和数量；不要把另一条链的查询结果混进来。

shots.source_visual_zh: 打开发送记录：网络、地址、数量、交易哈希；浏览器查询只读状态。

shots.visual_en: Branch cards: still pending → contact the sender; succeeded on-chain but not credited → contact the receiver; wrong network or tag → pause first.
shots.visual_zh: 分支卡：待发送找发送方；链上成功未入账找接收方；网络或标签错误先暂停。

text.en: The receiving platform may still need confirmations or an internal review. If the coin, network, address or memo was wrong, stop sending and give the facts to official support.
text.zh-Hans: 接收平台可能还需要确认数或内部审核。若币种、网络、地址或备注填错，先停止继续转账，提交事实资料给官方客服。

label.zh-Hans: 链上成功未入账 → 找接收方
网络或标签错误 → 先暂停

shots.source_visual_zh: 分支卡：待发送找发送方；链上成功未入账找接收方；网络或标签错误先暂停。

zh-Hans: 链上成功未入账 → 找接收方
网络或标签错误 → 先暂停

shots.visual_en: A stranger pops up: 'Pay an unlock fee, guaranteed recovery.' Sam closes it. A timeline that does not rewind.
shots.visual_zh: 陌生人弹出“交解冻费保证找回”，被小白关闭；时间线不倒流。

text.en: A completed on-chain transfer usually can't be undone like a normal action. Whether it can be recovered depends on technical and platform conditions. There's no guarantee. Don't believe anyone who says paying a fee will surely get it back.
text.zh-Hans: 通常不能像撤销普通操作一样撤回已完成的链上转账。是否能找回，要看技术和平台条件，不能保证；别相信付钱就必定找回。

shots.source_visual_zh: 陌生人弹出“交解冻费保证找回”，被小白关闭；时间线不倒流。

shots.visual_en: Question card: 'Does support need your transaction hash, or your recovery phrase?'
shots.visual_zh: 题目：客服排查需要哈希，还是助记词？

text.en: Give the records they need. Never the recovery phrase, private key or codes.
text.zh-Hans: 提供必要交易记录，不提供助记词、私钥和验证码。

text.en: Right. Find where it's stuck first. Don't keep sending.

question.en: Does support need your transaction hash, or your recovery phrase?
question.zh-Hans: 客服需要交易哈希，还是助记词？

shots.source_visual_zh: 题目：客服排查需要哈希，还是助记词？

text.en: 'Hi, I'm support. Send me your recovery phrase.' Next: what scammers really want.
text.zh-Hans: “我是客服，把恢复词发给我。”下一集：骗子到底要什么。

text.en: 'Hi, I'm support. Send me your recovery phrase.' Next: what scammers really want.
text.zh-Hans: “我是客服，把恢复词发给我。”下一集：骗子到底要什么。

end_hook.visual_en: End hook (4 s): quick teaser of the next problem — a single striking image from the next episode's opening, frozen on the moment of doubt; Sam reacts, Nexubo's antenna blinks amber. Text card with the hook line.
end_hook.visual_zh: 片尾钩子（4秒）：下一集开场矛盾的一个定格画面，停在“犯疑问”的瞬间；小白反应，小纳天线琥珀灯闪。字卡显示钩子台词。

close_visual_en: Branded close (4 s): logo mark + wordmark lockup, series name, tagline 'Understand first, then act.', small slogan line 'One verified gateway to the world's exchanges', 'nexualpha.com' as plain text (the clickable entry lives on the web page). Nexubo waves, antenna green.
close_visual_zh: 品牌片尾（4秒）：标志图形＋文字标、系列名、“先看懂，再动手。”、小号品牌标语“全球交易所，一个官方入口”；“nexualpha.com”为识别文字（可点击入口在网页）。小纳挥手，天线绿灯。

goal.en: Tell apart sender processing, on-chain confirmation and crediting by the receiver, and know the limited ways to fix things.
goal.zh-Hans: 能区分发送方处理、链上确认和平台入账，知道有限补救路径。

page_cta.line_en: Stuck transfer? Contact only the official support of the sending or receiving platform.
page_cta.line_zh: 转账卡住？只联系发送方或接收方平台的官方客服。
page_cta.placement: directly beside / under the video player; never gates the lesson

exercise.task_en: Match three problem scenarios to: the sender, the on-chain status and the receiver.
exercise.task_zh: 将三个故障场景匹配到发送方、链上状态和接收方。
exercise.answer_en: Find the status, then use the matching official channel. If the cause is unknown, don't pay again.
exercise.answer_zh: 定位状态再找相应官方渠道；未知原因不重复付款。

red_lines: On-chain completion does not mean the exchange has credited it ｜ 链上完成不代表交易所入账
Never say every wrong-chain transfer can be recovered, or can never be recovered ｜ 不得把所有错链都说成能找回或绝对无法找回
Logo mark + wordmark top-left on every shot, official SVG only ｜ 每个镜头左上角都有正式标志图形＋文字标，只用原始SVG
